shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着软刷站在离心机和转子旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a soft brush beside a benchtop centrifuge and a rotor resting on a mat, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：离心机的维护与转子退役。
overlay: 离心机的维护与转子退役

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣轻拍转子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gently pats a clean rotor like an old friend.
shots.narration: 转子转得快，更要勤保养。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰打开离心机，腔体里有干了的盐渍
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a centrifuge and finds dried white salt stains inside the chamber and on the rotor.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，转子上有一圈白色盐渍。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰想用钢丝球刷，被老李拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for a steel wool pad, and the facility engineer stops him with a raised hand.
shots.narration: 他想拿钢丝球刷，老李赶紧拦住。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老李拿出维护规程卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank maintenance procedure card and a soft brush.
shots.narration: 老李：维护有规程，一步都不能乱。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 高速转子和扳手、清洁布图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high speed rotor with a wrench and a cleaning cloth icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 转速越高，越要状态良好。
overlay: 定期维护是安全的基础

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 日历上定期打勾，坏了才修打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with regular ticks for maintenance, and a broken machine waiting for repair crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 定期维护，不能坏了才管。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 维护规程贴在离心机旁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank maintenance procedure sheet posted on the wall beside a centrifuge, an open manual below it. No text.
shots.narration: 方法以说明书为准，规程贴在旁边。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 王老师给学生讲维护，考核打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains students on centrifuge maintenance, and a tick appears on a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 使用和维护的人，都要先培训。

shots.section_title: 定期维护是安全的基础
shots.scene: 使用、维护、记录三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a hand using a centrifuge, a brush and a logbook. No text.
shots.narration: 小心使用、认真维护、如实记录。

shots.section_title: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳
shots.scene: 转子剖面，受力最大处出现腐蚀斑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of a rotor with force arrows and tiny corrosion spots at the most stressed area. No text.
shots.narration: 转子很结实，但怕腐蚀和金属疲劳。
overlay: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳

shots.section_title: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳
shots.scene: 盐和化学品残留让小斑点慢慢变大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: salt crystals on a rotor surface and a tiny pit growing larger step by step. No text.
shots.narration: 盐和化学品残留，会加速腐蚀。

shots.section_title: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳
shots.scene: 铝转子表面腐蚀更快
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light grey metal rotor with more corrosion spots than a darker metal rotor beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 铝转子更容易被腐蚀。

shots.section_title: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳
shots.scene: 运行次数增加，疲劳裂纹延伸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a run counter going up and a hairline crack slowly extending in a rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 用得越久，疲劳越重。

shots.section_title: 转子为什么会失效：腐蚀和疲劳
shots.scene: 受损转子高速旋转，危险标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged rotor spinning at high speed with a warning triangle above it. No text.
shots.narration: 受损转子高速转，就是隐患。

shots.section_title: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫
shots.scene: 关机、拔插头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off a centrifuge and pulling out the power plug. No text.
shots.narration: 维护前先关机，拔下电源插头。
overlay: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫

shots.section_title: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫
shots.scene: 确认转子停稳再开盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a speed display at zero and a lid opening only after the rotor has stopped. No text.
shots.narration: 确认转子完全停稳，再开盖。

shots.section_title: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服，戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves before servicing the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 穿实验服，戴护目镜和手套。

shots.section_title: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫
shots.scene: 【实拍】用专用扳手松开转子，双手取下（已断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a special wrench loosening the rotor nut, then two hands lifting the rotor straight up.
shots.narration: 用专用扳手松开，双手取下转子。

shots.section_title: 先断电停稳，取下转子放软垫
shots.scene: 转子放在软垫上，磕碰打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor placed on a soft rubber mat with a tick, and a rotor knocked against a hard bench edge crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 转子放在平稳的软垫上，别磕碰。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 中性清洗剂和软布，强酸强碱、钢丝球打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mild neutral detergent bottle and a soft cloth with a tick, a strong acid bottle, a strong alkali bottle and steel wool crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用中性清洗剂，不用强酸强碱、钢丝球。
overlay: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 擦机壳外面和转子腔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damp wrung out cloth wiping the outside of a centrifuge and the inside of the chamber. No text.
shots.narration: 机壳、转子腔和附件都擦干净。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 布拧干，液体流进电机打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cloth being wrung out, and liquid dripping into the motor area crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 布要拧干，别让液体流进电机。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 擦掉盐垢和化学品残留，不留死角
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cloth wiping away white salt crust from the edge of the chamber and corners. No text.
shots.narration: 盐垢和化学品残留，彻底擦掉。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 溅洒后立刻清洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spill in the rotor with a clock showing right away and a cleaning cloth. No text.
shots.narration: 有溅洒或用过盐溶液，立即清洗。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 【实拍】用非金属头试管刷逐个刷转子孔（空转子）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a bristle brush with a plastic tip cleaning the holes of a rotor one by one down to the bottom.
shots.narration: 转子孔用非金属头刷子，刷到底。

shots.section_title: 中性清洗剂温和清洁，擦净盐垢
shots.scene: 金属头刷子划伤孔壁，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brush with a sharp metal wire tip scratching the inside of a rotor hole, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 金属头会划伤孔壁，不要用。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 清水冲洗转子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: clean water rinsing a rotor held over a sink. No text.
shots.narration: 刷完用清水冲洗干净。
overlay: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 转子整个泡在水桶里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a whole rotor submerged in a bucket of water, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要把转子整个泡进水里。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 【实拍】转子倒扣在软垫上沥干（空转子）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a rotor turned upside down on a soft mat so the water drains out of its holes.
shots.narration: 冲完倒扣沥干，让孔里的水流出。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 先水洗，后消毒，箭头顺序
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two steps with an arrow, water rinsing first, then a disinfectant wipe. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时再消毒：先水洗，后消毒。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 醇类消毒液远离火源，通风晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an alcohol disinfectant bottle away from a flame symbol, a rotor air drying near an open window. No text.
shots.narration: 醇类消毒液易燃，远离火源，晾干再用。

shots.section_title: 清水冲洗不浸泡，必要时再消毒
shots.scene: 消毒剂与转子材料是否相容，查说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a disinfectant bottle and a rotor with a manual between them, a corroded metal icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 消毒剂要和转子材料相容，查说明书。

shots.section_title: 洗净晾干，再薄涂润滑脂
shots.scene: 洗净、消毒、晾干三步打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three ticked steps, a clean rotor, a disinfected rotor and an air dried rotor, then a grease jar. No text.
shots.narration: 洗净、消毒、晾干后，再润滑。
overlay: 洗净晾干，再薄涂润滑脂

shots.section_title: 洗净晾干，再薄涂润滑脂
shots.scene: 【实拍】指尖取少量专用润滑脂涂在螺纹和密封圈上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved fingertip with a tiny dab of grease spreading it thinly on rotor lid threads and a rubber seal ring.
shots.narration: 一点点专用润滑脂，涂螺纹和密封圈。

shots.section_title: 洗净晾干，再薄涂润滑脂
shots.scene: 吊篮槽和枢轴上点涂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: grease points on the bucket slots and pivot pins of a swing out rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 吊篮槽和枢轴，也要照顾到。

shots.section_title: 洗净晾干，再薄涂润滑脂
shots.scene: 厚厚一层油粘满灰尘，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick blob of grease covered with dust on a rotor thread, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 薄薄一层就够，多了反而粘灰。

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 【实拍】手电照查转子孔底和边缘（空转子）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a small flashlight shining into rotor holes while gloved fingers turn the rotor slowly.
shots.narration: 每次都查转子，孔底和边缘都要看。
overlay: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 细裂纹、点蚀、白色粉末、变色四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four close-up icons on a rotor surface, a hairline crack, small pits, white powder and discoloration. No text.
shots.narration: 裂纹、点蚀、白粉、变色，都是警报。

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 表面粗糙，放大镜检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a rough patch on the rotor surface. No text.
shots.narration: 表面发糙，也不能放过。

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 发现损伤，转子停用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged rotor set aside with a stop symbol and a blank tag. No text.
shots.narration: 发现任何损伤，立即停用。

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 坏转子继续装机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand putting a cracked rotor back into a centrifuge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 损伤转子不能再用，要更换。

shots.section_title: 检查裂纹和腐蚀，有损伤立即停用
shots.scene: 密封圈有裂纹，换新的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked rubber seal ring replaced with a new one. No text.
shots.narration: 密封圈有裂纹缺口，及时更换。

shots.section_title: 拿不准请专业检测，记录并贴标识
shots.scene: 看不准，交给老李
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a rotor to the facility engineer with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 看不准，别凭感觉，交给专业人员。
overlay: 拿不准请专业检测，记录并贴标识

shots.section_title: 拿不准请专业检测，记录并贴标识
shots.scene: 技术人员用内窥镜查孔内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained technician using a slim inspection camera to look inside a rotor hole, the image shown on a blank screen. No text.
shots.narration: 专业检测，看清孔内看不到的地方。

shots.section_title: 拿不准请专业检测，记录并贴标识
shots.scene: 检测结果写进记录，转子贴标识
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inspection result written into a record book and a small blank inspection sticker placed on the rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 结果写进记录，检测过的贴上标识。

shots.section_title: 拿不准请专业检测，记录并贴标识
shots.scene: 联系设备管理部门或厂家授权维修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone call to an equipment office and an authorised service technician arriving with a toolbox. No text.
shots.narration: 联系设备管理部门或授权维修。

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 转子像沙漏，终有退役一天
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor next to an hourglass with sand running out. No text.
shots.narration: 每个转子都有寿命，终有退役一天。
overlay: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 转子使用日志：日期、转子、转速、次数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor logbook with four blank columns and a pen. No text.
shots.narration: 每次使用都登记，写进转子日志。

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 超速转子老化，最高转速刻度下调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an aging ultracentrifuge rotor and its maximum speed mark moved down on a gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 老化的超速转子，最高转速要降级。

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 到期转子放进退役箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an expired rotor placed into a retired equipment box with a blank label. No text.
shots.narration: 到期降速或退役，以说明书为准。

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 没有日志的转子像定时炸弹，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotor without a logbook drawn with a ticking clock, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没记录的超速转子，就是定时炸弹。

shots.section_title: 转子寿命：使用日志、降速、按时退役
shots.scene: 维护记录：日期、做了什么、谁做的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance record with three blank columns and a signature line. No text.
shots.narration: 维护也登记：日期、内容、谁做的。

shots.section_title: 损坏停用挂牌，报修不私修
shots.scene: 离心机挂空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank out of service tag hung on a centrifuge and its rotor set aside. No text.
shots.narration: 设备或转子有问题，马上停用挂牌。
overlay: 损坏停用挂牌，报修不私修

shots.section_title: 损坏停用挂牌，报修不私修
shots.scene: 报告实验室负责人，走报修流程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report form going to the lab supervisor and then to the repair service. No text.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，走报修流程。

shots.section_title: 损坏停用挂牌，报修不私修
shots.scene: 学生拆离心机，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student opening a centrifuge housing with a screwdriver, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不自行拆修，由专业人员维修。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 断电、清洁、冲洗、润滑四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a pulled plug, a soft brush, a water rinse and a grease dab. No text.
shots.narration: 断电取下，温和清洁，沥干再润滑。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 检查、专业检测两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a flashlight checking a rotor and an inspection sticker. No text.
shots.narration: 每次检查，拿不准就请专业检测。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 日志、降速、退役、停用牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a rotor logbook, a lowered speed gauge, a retired box and an out of service tag. No text.
shots.narration: 记日志，按时降速退役，坏了停用。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在高压灭菌器旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed laboratory autoclave and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：高压灭菌器与压力容器。
